title: Groups membership view and last-sync as of
summary: Admin Groups member counts open a live directory membership view, and the Groups totals caption shows when the catalogue was last synced.
changes: Make Access Groups member counts open a membership page that lists live directory members for that group.
Fail closed when the directory cannot be read so membership details stay hidden, and do not start a directory sync from that page.
Show the catalogue last-sync time as an as-of stamp next to the Groups totals.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds a Groups membership view and last-sync as-of display without changing directory sync lease or scheduling.
validation: PHPUnit AdminGroupMembershipTest covers clickable counts, last-sync as-of, live membership listing, fail-closed directory errors, permission denial, and unmanaged group 404.
PHPUnit AdminAccessWorkspaceTest and AdminDirectoryManagementTest still pass for Access Groups redirects and mappings.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Membership is read live from the directory; catalogue member counts can differ briefly until the next successful sync.
Directory sync behaviour, lease, and scheduling are unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the membership view and Groups last-sync as-of stamp.
provenance: Groups membership view and last-sync as-of for issues #140 and #145, pull request #240.
